title: Subscription refresh
description: UI refreshes usage and plan state after assistant calls that return usage metadata.
content:
Subscription refresh

UI refreshes usage and plan state after assistant calls that return usage metadata.

What this is

After assistant responses that include usage metadata, Oasis refreshes subscription and quota state so the token bar and any badges stay current.

How to use it

  • No manual refresh button is required in normal use.
  • If totals look wrong, send a short follow-up message to force another round trip.
  • Sign out/in if account state disagrees with the website for more than a few minutes.

Notes and limits

Partial failures fall back to cached limits; the UI should indicate uncertainty when that happens.
